llm.summary: The skill's requirements, instructions, and included scripts are consistent with a Dingtalk/MCP document helper; the only noteworthy risk is trusting the external mcporter npm CLI and protecting the DINGTALK_MCP_DOCS_URL token.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the requested binaries (mcporter), the declared env var (DINGTALK_MCP_DOCS_URL), and the included scripts (create/import/export). Requested artifacts are proportionate to the stated functions (create, read, search, write documents).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the Python scripts only instruct use of the mcporter CLI and safely-scoped local file operations. Scripts limit file size, extensions, and workspace path; they call mcporter via subprocess without shell interpolation (list args), and only read/write files when performing import/export features, which matches the skill purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Skill is instruction-only (no platform install spec). It recommends installing mcporter via npm/bun (npm install -g mcporter). This is expected for a CLI-based integration but requires trusting the external npm package and global installation; review mcporter's provenance before installing globally.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only DINGTALK_MCP_DOCS_URL is required (primary credential) and is justified — it contains the Streamable HTTP URL/token for the MCP server. The optional OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE variable is used only to limit file IO. No unrelated secrets or configs are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills, and has normal autonomous-invocation defaults. It does not attempt to persist global agent settings; recommended credential storage (mcporter config) is documented.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and implements reasonable safety checks. Before installing: 1) Verify the mcporter npm package and its publisher (installing global npm CLIs requires trust). 2) Treat DINGTALK_MCP_DOCS_URL like a password — prefer mcporter config over exporting it as an env var and do not commit it to source control. 3) Use a test workspace (set OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE) when importing/exporting to enforce the scripts' sandboxing. 4) If you need higher assurance, review the mcporter CLI source and the skill's package.json/homepage (the repository URL is present in the package files) before installing.
